Agent Name: Engineer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer implemented an O(n^2) solution using nested loops to check for overlaps, which violates the O(n log n) time complexity constraint specified in the problem. The solution sorts the meetings (O(n log n)) but then iterates through each meeting and checks all subsequent meetings (O(n^2) in the worst case). Additionally, the logic is flawed: it only adds the *next* meeting to the conflicts list when an overlap is found, but doesn't properly handle cases where a meeting overlaps with multiple other meetings (it would only be added once, which is correct), but more importantly, it fails to correctly identify all overlapping meetings in the original order. The correct approach should use a sweep-line algorithm or sort by start time and track the maximum end time seen so far to identify conflicts in O(n log n) time.
